name: Bobby Dodd Stadium at Hyundai Field

bagPolicy.summary: Bobby Dodd Stadium at Hyundai Field does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Georgia Tech publishes event-specific parking lots, permits, shuttles, and access routes. Review the current football parking page before arrival; many stadium-adjacent lots require advance credentials.

rideshare.note: For Georgia Tech events, rideshare pickup and drop-off is on Tech Parkway, in the parallel parking spaces off North Avenue. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

concessions.note: The stadium offers modern concessions to enhance visitor experience, though specific food and drink options are not detailed. Guests can expect comfort and convenience with upgraded facilities.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair, scooter, and mobility seating is located throughout the stadium; arrange tickets in advance with the Georgia Tech Ticket Office at 1-888-TECH-TIX. Leashed service animals are welcome. An elevator reachable from outside is at Gate 6, and there are elevators at Sections 105 and 108 for guests using Gates 1 and 4.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: You can't exit and re-enter the stadium using the same ticket.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For Georgia Tech events, mobile tickets are required for entry. Will call is at the Fanning Center Box Office on Bobby Dodd Way NW.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The dedicated media entrance is located at Gate 6 on the north side of the stadium.
